task: put the bowl on the plate

windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the bowl.
Approach the bowl from above, lowering the open gripper toward its rim.
Approach the bowl from above, lowering the open gripper down toward its rim.
Grasp the bowl by closing the gripper fingers around its rim while it rests on the table.
Grasp the bowl and lift it vertically off the table.
Carry the bowl horizontally across the table toward the plate.
Lower the bowl down onto the plate.
Release the bowl onto the plate and open the gripper fingers.
